summary: Players can own, power, load and configure modular turret bases whose attached turret heads acquire legal targets and fire using server-authoritative state.

authoritative_state: TurretBaseBlockEntity owns energy, inventory, owner UUID, local trust, target rules, range, activity and kill statistics.
TurretHeadBlockEntity owns target acquisition, cooldown, aim, ammunition and energy consumption.
SecuritySavedData owns global and shared trust mappings.
Clients submit bounded intents and never author damage, energy, inventory, ownership or target selection.

schema.owner: TurretBaseBlockEntity, TurretHeadBlockEntity, InventoryExpanderBlockEntity, SecuritySavedData and MemoryCardProfile
fields: schema_version:int=1 and unsupported future versions are rejected
base owner UUID, energy, 13-slot inventory, target flags, range, active state, trust entries and statistics
turret cooldown, auto-fire, concealment, targeting priorities and minimal render aim
memory card Data Component containing bounded copyable base settings without energy, inventory or ownership

flows.purpose: Apply a bounded base setting intent while the sender has the matching menu open.
validation: Loaded block entity, same dimension, interaction distance and matching open menu.
Sender access level authorizes the selected action.
Enum id and operand are clamped to server-owned limits.

flows.purpose: Mutate a bounded local or owner-global trust entry.
validation: Sender UUID is derived from payload context and is never supplied by the payload.
Local changes require an owned loaded base in interaction range.
Target UUID, access id and entry count are bounded.

flows.purpose: Expose at most 64 authorized trust entries to the current menu viewer.
validation: Client accepts only bounded entries associated with the currently viewed base.

flows.purpose: Synchronize bounded authoritative yaw and pitch for rendering.
validation: Client verifies a loaded turret block entity exists at the supplied position.

flows.purpose: Render a bounded cosmetic beam after the server has resolved damage.
validation: Client clamps duration and ignores effects outside the loaded level.

client_boundary.dedicated_server_fallback: All authoritative targeting, energy, ammunition and damage behavior runs without loading client classes.

generated: Blockstates, block/item models, loot tables, recipes, item/block tags and en_us/zh_cn language JSON.
manual: GPL-compatible legacy OMT textures and sounds with retained OMLib MIT notice.

budgets.scope: 100 loaded idle turret heads staggered across search phases
budgets.measurement: Warm for 200 ticks and sample 1000 server ticks with target searches staggered by position.

hot_paths: Payload validation and menu state synchronization
performance.measurement_environment: Java 21, 1 GiB heap, fixed GameTest world, 100 turret heads and 100 hostile entities.

mods.fallback: The mod refuses to load outside the pinned NeoForge 21.1 line.

covers: Target acquisition work is staggered and bounded for 100 loaded turret heads.
tests.expected: The 100-head fixture schedules no more than 20 scans on one tick.

steps: Place a tiered base and attach a compatible turret head.
Supply energy and tagged ammunition, then enable hostile targeting.
Save and reload the world, reconnect, and inspect the base and turret state.
manual_checks.expected: The turret fires only at legal visible targets, consumes server-owned resources, and preserves its configuration.

non_goals: Direct loading or in-place DataFixerUpper migration of Minecraft 1.12 worlds.
ComputerCraft, OpenComputers, IC2, Tesla, old RF, Waila, Jade or JEI integration.
Standalone OMLib publication, debug_tool, multi_tool, fake_sword and Potentia fluid restoration.
Legacy network cable and external controller APIs.
